verdict.rationale: JumpCloud docs describe HRIS-driven onboarding/offboarding and lifecycle automation (identity creation, access changes, termination) tied to HR system events, which covers hire/departure choreography, but there's no explicit evidence of a no-code visual workflow builder for role-change triggers — automation is largely framed around APIs/PowerShell/bulk operations rather than declarative no-code workflows. missing for 10: explicit no-code workflow builder UI, role-change-specific automation examples, independent hands-on confirmation of app-by-app choreography working end-to-end.
